Class TrackBuilder

java.lang.Object
uno.anahata.asi.yam.games.asikart.TrackBuilder
public class TrackBuilder extends Object
TrackBuilder — Specialized 3D Circuit Generator for AsiKart 3D.

Supports multiple 3D circuits:

  • TrackBuilder.CircuitType.RAINBOW_CIRCUIT — High-altitude cosmic track surrounded by starfield and neon light-rails.
  • TrackBuilder.CircuitType.DESERT_SPEEDWAY — Sun-scorched desert raceway with dunes, palm trees, and ancient stone arches.
  • TrackBuilder.CircuitType.CYBER_CIRCUIT — Futuristic neon-grid circuit set in a synthwave cyber metropolis.

Features 3D Sky Dome, PBR Asphalt/Grass normal bump textures, 3D Finish Arches, and thematic scenery trees.

Author:
anahata
